rewrite_rules._comment: Codified 'Needs a rewrite' rules for short descriptions that exist but won't hold up. Each enabled rule that fires adds one reason.

min_words.message: Too short to stand on its own ({n} words).

relative_date.message: Uses a relative date (“{match}”) that goes stale.

list_fragment.message: Reads as a list of workstreams, not a description of the outcome.

no_outcome_cue.message: No outcome or success criterion stated.

palette._comment: Hex values from signatry-brand-core. Light / dark pairs.

queries.jql: project in (TRM) AND statusCategory != Done AND "Roadmap" NOT IN ("Done", "Parking Lot", "Won't do") ORDER BY key ASC
queries.description: Product group ideas that may need QA (whole team).

queries.jql: key in (TRM-158, TRM-161, TRM-289, TRM-295, TRM-303, TRM-315, TRM-317, TRM-325, TRM-331, TRM-332, TRM-341, TRM-342, TRM-357, TRM-363, TRM-366, TRM-368, TRM-373, TRM-383, TRM-388, TRM-400, TRM-401, TRM-404, TRM-405, TRM-409, TRM-410, TRM-440, TRM-444, TRM-445) ORDER BY key ASC
queries.description: Every agenda key, including closed, archived, or Roadmap-excluded ideas, so the corrections section can name them.

queries.jql: project in (TRM) AND "Roadmap" = "Done" AND updated >= "2026-09-01" ORDER BY key ASC
queries.description: Ideas delivered inside the chart window. The updated bound is a fetch-volume guard; the real filter (exact Project target between chart start and today) runs in Python.
